changelog.summary: Adds a transaction-to-fulfillment decision handoff with capture proof, owner approval, and provider receipts.

title: Payment Exception to Order Decision
description: Investigate an order payment exception, decide whether fulfillment must wait or can be reviewed for release, and verify any approved action.
setup_prompt: Use Payment Exception to Order Decision as a chat-led proposal for one authorized Shopify order and transaction exception. Discover existing Payment Operations Investigator and Store Operations Coordinator Crews; propose reuse or reviewed creation. Inspect current OrderTransaction kind/status, parent, currency, gateway, order financial and FulfillmentOrder state, capture policy, and owner. Show the validated payment-to-fulfillment handoff, approval gate, manual first run, and verification plan before Builder applies it. Selection alone does not capture, void, refund, mark paid, release fulfillment, contact a buyer, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Store, order, case, transaction and presentment currency
Merchant capture and fulfillment-release policy with owner
Authorized transaction, order, fulfillment, and gateway records or exports
One bounded authorization, pending, or failed-payment case
Manual-only or reviewed event and notification route

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing Crews with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded transaction artifact

recommended_tools.name: Shopify Admin or bounded transaction export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact OrderTransaction kind, status, amount, and parent

recommended_tools.name: Payment provider or gateway
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify external capture or failure where Shopify evidence is incomplete

recommended_tools.name: Shopify FulfillmentOrder or provider
recommended_tools.purpose: Read affected fulfillment state and later release receipt

pulse_focus.label: Payment exception follow-through
focus_areas: Whether payment exceptions reach the correct owner before fulfillment
Whether release or customer action is based on successful transaction and provider evidence
review_when: An authorization nears expiry, a transaction changes state, or an approved release lacks a receipt

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and transaction source map
Provider-confirmed action and later order/fulfillment check when executed
